spanish: Seis días será hecha obra, y en el día el séptimo será a ustedes santidad, descanso de reposo solemne a Jehová; todo el que hace en él obra será muerto.
grammarChanges: Translated the construct pair shabat/shabatón into Spanish lexemes ('descanso' for the construct, 'reposo solemne' for the intensified absolute) instead of leaving them as untranslated transliterations.
Changed 'morirá' to 'será muerto' so the hophal imperfect 3ms (yumat, passive causative 'be put to death') is not flattened into a simple active future.
Changed the ungrammatical gerund-as-noun 'el haciendo' to the substantized participle 'el que hace' so the doer is a clear nominal subject of the death clause, without altering who acts on whom.
readerNote: Chose the substantized participle 'el que hace' over the gerund 'el haciendo' to supply a clear subject for the death clause; this is a grammatical choice, not a change of participants.
